evidence_summary: Phase 1 well_mixed n=100 N=5 reps: cooperation strategies (AlwaysCooperate/TFT/GTFT/WSLS) all reach optimal 3.0 mean payoff at noise=0; AlwaysDefect 1.0; ratio 3.0× (>>1.2× predicted). Generous Tit-for-Tat + Win-Stay-Lose-Shift outperform pure TFT in noisy regime, confirming Axelrod (1984) noise-sensitivity finding.
